transcriptions.text: Supplementary Figure 4. Vβ gene usage of the TCRB (TCRβ) repertoire.

Supplementary Figure 4. Vβ gene usage of the TCRB (TCRβ) repertoire. (A) Distribution of Vß gene usage of T cell clones from all samples analysed (sum of productive frequencies). (B) Vß gene usage of TIL clones (n=1382) regarding their distribution patterns (frequency). (C) Vß gene usage of TIL clones (n=706) that persisted in the follow-up sample (PBMC-POST-4 ∩ TIL) regarding their distribution patterns (frequency).
